job_title: AI Developer Intern - Implementation Test Automation
preferred_skills: software test automation tools (Playwright, Selenium, pytest)
experience contributing to production software projects
education_requirements: Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Mathematics, Software Engineering, or a related technical field
key_responsibilities: Design, build, and enhance features within an AI-powered test automation platform
Collaborate with implementation consultants to map manual testing workflows and identify automation opportunities
Develop AI-driven workflows using Azure OpenAI, LangChain, RAG, and agentic AI frameworks
Build capabilities for automated test case generation, execution, and intelligent analysis of test results
Develop backend services using Python and SQL and contribute to front-end functionality using React and JavaScript
Measure and analyze effectiveness of automation by tracking metrics such as hours saved, test coverage improvements, and earlier defect detection
Document technical solutions and communicate findings to technical and business stakeholders

company_research.summary: Dayforce is a global leader in Human Capital Management (HCM) software, recently transitioning to a privately-held company after a $12.3 billion acquisition by Thoma Bravo in early 2026. The company employs over 9,000 people and maintains a strong market position, consistently recognized as a leader in Gartner’s Magic Quadrant for cloud HCM suites. For the AI Developer Intern role, candidates will work in an innovation lab environment, focusing on using Large Language Models (LLMs) and automation to streamline internal workflows and implementation testing. Employee feedback generally highlights a positive work-life balance (4.0/5 on Glassdoor) and a supportive, hybrid-friendly culture, though some reviews note the fast-paced nature of a large enterprise undergoing ownership changes.
